subject: How was CVPR?
text:
Hi Joohey,

Hope you had a productive time at CVPR. Whether we connected at CVPR or you're discovering Encord: https://encord.com/?utm_campaign=126075099-202506-post-cvpr-outreach&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_content=tn-post-cvpr for the first time, we wanted to share some standout moments from this year's conference.

Notable talks:
Oxford's open-vocabulary segmentation approach: Their CVPR paper: https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025/papers/Lai_Exploring_Simple_Open-Vocabulary_Semantic_Segmentation_CVPR_2025_paper.pdf demonstrates that simple pseudo-mask generation and direct pixel-language alignment can achieve competitive results without relying on CLIP, SAM, or ground truth annotations. Wayve and NVIDIA’s synthetic world models: Both teams demonstrated impressive video generation capabilities at the Embodied AI workshop. NVIDIA's COSMOS and Wayve's Gaia 2 are capable of creating controlled synthetic data for edge cases like weather events and complex driving scenarios. Encord at CVPR:
Our customer, Zeitview, presented a multi-spectral segmentation breakthrough: The team shared their research on cascaded deep learning for multimodal infrared and RGB imagery fusion. Encord's platform supported their data pipeline for this research: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.02128. Hi Chitrang,

Hope you had a productive time at CVPR. Whether we connected at CVPR or you're discovering Encord: https://encord.com/?utm_campaign=126075099-202506-post-cvpr-outreach&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_content=tn-post-cvpr for the first time, we wanted to share some standout moments from this year's conference.

Notable talks:
Oxford's open-vocabulary segmentation approach: Their CVPR paper: https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025/papers/Lai_Exploring_Simple_Open-Vocabulary_Semantic_Segmentation_CVPR_2025_paper.pdf demonstrates that simple pseudo-mask generation and direct pixel-language alignment can achieve competitive results without relying on CLIP, SAM, or ground truth annotations. Wayve and NVIDIA’s synthetic world models: Both teams demonstrated impressive video generation capabilities at the Embodied AI workshop. NVIDIA's COSMOS and Wayve's Gaia 2 are capable of creating controlled synthetic data for edge cases like weather events and complex driving scenarios. Encord at CVPR:
Our customer, Zeitview, presented a multi-spectral segmentation breakthrough: The team shared their research on cascaded deep learning for multimodal infrared and RGB imagery fusion. Encord's platform supported their data pipeline for this research: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.02128.
